correctness.rationale: For x=(t,y), condition on t and use uniform y/sqrt(1-t²) on S^{d-2}. Orthogonality to constants of the transverse traceless quadratics, parity, and isotropy give the five reducing spaces, with dimensions 1,d−1,1,d−1,(d−2)(d+1)/2 over C; complexification introduces no new eigenvalues. Normalizing by the whole-sphere second and fourth moments gives exactly the five integrands. The increasing density ratios A/D, D/B and D/E prove strict upper-tail comparisons. Independently differentiating c(1−c²)^((d−1)/2)(a+b c²) after dividing out the cap density gives the polynomial a+(3b−da)c²−(d+2)b c⁴. For C−D and C−A the coefficient pairs are (−d−2,d(d+2)) and (−d−2,d²) with the common factor k_d/(d−1); matching derivatives and the vanishing endpoint at c=1 proves the exact identities. This gives 0<c₁<c₂<1 in every d≥3, the stated runner-up tie at c₁ and the two-dimensional top at c₂. Projecting onto both axial lines at c₂ leaves A−D, not zero, as the sharp gap; the nearest distinct lower eigenspace attains the deficit bound. Taylor expansion in 1/d gives the stated pinching. The comparison is of eigenvalue types, not a multiplicity-counted ordering at the top tie.
residual_risks: Only the stated band, equal antipodal caps, and interior cutoffs in integer d≥3 are covered.
